titleEn: AI NVM Opportunities — Persistent State at the Right Boundary
titleZh: AI NVM 機會地圖——讓持久狀態留在正確的系統邊界

sourceDocument.title: Architecture Vision: Open Silicon Photonics for AI Systems

centralThesisEn: AI systems do not need more nonvolatile bits everywhere. They need the right persistent state at each boundary.
centralThesisZh: AI 系統需要的不是到處增加 NVM，而是讓每一個系統邊界保存正確的狀態。
criticalBoundaryEn: The supplied OCP paper contains no OTP-memory requirement. Its MTP occurrences refer to MPO/MTP optical connectors. Every OTP/MTP placement in this package is therefore labeled as an architecture inference unless another cited source establishes it.
criticalBoundaryZh: 提供的 OCP 論文沒有提出 OTP 記憶體需求，其中的 MTP 均指 MPO/MTP 光纖接頭。因此，本資料包中的 OTP/MTP 配置，除非另有引用來源明確建立，皆標示為架構推論。
copilotAnswerRuleEn: Return the claim with claim status, evidence class, assurance maturity, source URL or source locator, scope, limitation, reviewed date and open question. Never present an inferred storage placement as a source requirement.
copilotAnswerRuleZh: 回答時必須同時提供主張、主張狀態、證據類別、確證成熟度、來源網址或來源定位、適用範圍、限制、審閱日期與待確認問題；不得把推論出的儲存配置描述成來源要求。

evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionEn: The cited standards or architecture source explicitly states the function or contract.
evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionZh: 引用的標準或架構來源明確提出該功能或介面契約。

evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionEn: A shipped product or official implementation demonstrates the cited behavior.
evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionZh: 已出貨產品或官方實作證明了所引用的行為。

evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionEn: A vendor describes an IP or product envelope; this is not independent assurance.
evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionZh: 供應商描述其 IP 或產品能力範圍，但不代表獨立確證。

evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionEn: The storage placement is derived from a system need and is not a requirement of the cited source.
evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionZh: 儲存配置由系統需求推導而來，並非引用來源的明文要求。

evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionEn: Node, workload, security or lifecycle evidence is still required before selection.
evidenceClassDefinitions.definitionZh: 選型前仍需補齊製程節點、工作負載、安全性或生命週期證據。

researchInputs.title: The AI Peripheral Blueprint
researchInputs.evidenceDispositionEn: Source-discovery and hypothesis input only; this synthesis is not primary evidence and cannot establish a product, standards or market requirement. The PDF is an image-only NotebookLM synthesis with no visible citations or reference list. Page locators identify synthesis claims only—not upstream evidence.
researchInputs.evidenceDispositionZh: 僅供來源探索與假設形成；此綜整不是一級證據，不能建立產品、標準或市場要求。此 PDF 為影像式 NotebookLM 綜整，未提供可見引用或參考文獻；頁碼僅定位綜整主張，不代表上游證據。
researchInputs.permittedUseEn: Use the domain map to prioritize standards clauses, product documents, workload measurements and target-customer discovery.
researchInputs.permittedUseZh: 可用其領域地圖排列標準條文、產品文件、工作負載量測與目標客戶訪談的驗證優先順序。
researchInputs.excludedUseEn: Do not repeat its volume figures, mandatory-technology language, yield claims or physical-invisibility claims without independent primary evidence.
researchInputs.excludedUseZh: 在沒有獨立一級證據前，不得轉述其數量、強制技術、良率或物理不可見等主張。

hypotheses.titleEn: Companion-chip expansion is a market-sizing hypothesis
hypotheses.titleZh: 周邊晶片擴張仍是待量化的市場假設
hypotheses.statementEn: AI platforms may create recurring persistence contracts across SPD hubs and PMICs, retimers, BMCs, storage and network controllers, and memory-repair domains.
hypotheses.statementZh: AI 平台可能在 SPD hub／PMIC、retimer、BMC、儲存與網路控制器及記憶體修復領域形成重複出現的持久狀態契約。
hypotheses.excludedClaimEn: The synthesis does not prove any platform quantity, universal upgrade cycle or addressable-market multiplier.
hypotheses.excludedClaimZh: 此綜整不能證明任何平台數量、通用升級週期或可服務市場倍數。
hypotheses.validationNeededEn: Validate platform bills of material, architecture ownership and current product roadmaps by deployment class.
hypotheses.validationNeededZh: 需依部署類型驗證平台 BOM、架構責任歸屬與現行產品 roadmap。

hypotheses.titleEn: SPD-hub and PMIC persistence workloads need product proof
hypotheses.titleZh: SPD hub 與 PMIC 的持久狀態工作負載需要產品證據
hypotheses.statementEn: Startup configuration, trim, identity or VPD, and bounded fault history are candidate persistence contracts; the medium and endurance remain product-specific.
hypotheses.statementZh: 啟動設定、trim、identity／VPD 與有界 fault history 是候選持久狀態契約；儲存媒體與耐久度仍依產品而定。
hypotheses.excludedClaimEn: The synthesis does not establish a universal MTP mandate or a universal 100K-cycle JEDEC requirement. It also does not establish that temperature telemetry or dynamic voltage compensation is itself an NVM workload.
hypotheses.excludedClaimZh: 此綜整沒有建立通用 MTP 強制要求，也沒有證明 JEDEC 對所有情境要求 100K 次循環；此 PDF 也未證明 temperature telemetry 或 dynamic voltage compensation 本身就是 NVM workload。
hypotheses.validationNeededEn: Locate the exact standards clauses, official product data and measured write cadence before selecting OTP, MTP or EEPROM.
hypotheses.validationNeededZh: 在選擇 OTP、MTP 或 EEPROM 前，需取得精確標準條文、官方產品資料與實測寫入頻率。

hypotheses.titleEn: Retimer persistence must be separated from live equalization
hypotheses.titleZh: Retimer 持久狀態必須與即時等化分開
hypotheses.statementEn: Factory trim or a qualified cold-start profile may persist; live equalization and training remain volatile. Placement, medium and update cadence are product-specific.
hypotheses.statementZh: Factory trim 或 qualified cold-start profile 可能需要持久化；即時 equalization 與 training 維持揮發性，配置位置、媒體與更新頻率仍依產品而定。
hypotheses.excludedClaimEn: The synthesis does not prove that anti-fuse OTP is mandatory for every PCIe retimer or PHY.
hypotheses.excludedClaimZh: 此綜整不能證明所有 PCIe retimer 或 PHY 都必須使用 AntiFuse OTP。
hypotheses.validationNeededEn: Verify the target retimer lifecycle, trim authority, training behavior, update count and recovery-time objective from primary documents.
hypotheses.validationNeededZh: 需由一級文件驗證目標 retimer 的生命週期、trim authority、training 行為、更新次數與 recovery-time objective。

hypotheses.titleEn: Trust-anchor placement requires authority mapping and physical evidence
hypotheses.titleZh: 信任根配置需要責任地圖與物理攻擊證據
hypotheses.statementEn: BMC, DPU and accelerator trust roots and policy state require product-specific authority mapping plus fault, side-channel and invasive-attack evaluation.
hypotheses.statementZh: BMC、DPU 與 accelerator 的 trust root 與 policy state，需要依產品建立 authority map，並接受 fault、side-channel 與 invasive attack 評估。
hypotheses.excludedClaimEn: The synthesis does not prove that Caliptra mandates PUF or anti-fuse, that any root is invisible or unextractable under physical attack, or that BMC/DPU is the authoritative trust root for every platform.
hypotheses.excludedClaimZh: 此綜整不能證明 Caliptra 強制採用 PUF 或 AntiFuse，也不能證明任何信任根在物理攻擊下不可見或不可擷取，更不能把 BMC／DPU 視為所有平台的唯一 authoritative trust root。
hypotheses.validationNeededEn: Validate the target threat model, provisioning flow, debug and DFT exposure, key lifecycle, and certification evidence.
hypotheses.validationNeededZh: 需驗證目標威脅模型、provisioning flow、debug／DFT exposure、key lifecycle 與認證證據。

hypotheses.titleEn: SRAM repair metadata is a bounded-state opportunity
hypotheses.titleZh: SRAM 修復 metadata 是有界狀態機會
hypotheses.statementEn: Small immutable or bounded-mutable repair metadata may justify local NVM, while payload and runtime state remain volatile and repair authority remains explicit.
hypotheses.statementZh: 少量不可變或有限次可更新的 repair metadata 可能適合 local NVM；payload 與 runtime state 保持揮發性，repair authority 必須明確。
hypotheses.excludedClaimEn: The synthesis does not prove a universal yield gain, 0.55 V programming, lifetime field repair, eFuse unsuitability, or anti-fuse as the only viable repair implementation.
hypotheses.excludedClaimZh: 此綜整不能證明通用良率提升、0.55 V 編程、終身 field repair、eFuse 不適用，或 AntiFuse 是唯一可行的修復實作。
hypotheses.validationNeededEn: Measure target defect distributions, spare topology, program envelope, repair-event count, retention and attestation coherence.
hypotheses.validationNeededZh: 需量測目標 defect distribution、spare topology、program envelope、repair event count、retention 與 attestation coherence。

records.titleEn: Management and telemetry remain a technology-neutral contract
records.titleZh: 管理與遙測維持技術中立的介面契約
records.claimEn: The architecture standardizes a management and telemetry contract while leaving internal sensors, firmware and diagnostics as implementation choices.
records.claimZh: 此架構將管理與遙測介面標準化，同時把內部感測器、韌體與診斷機制保留為實作選擇。
records.applicabilityEn: Defines the observable boundary for optical-engine and platform management integration.
records.applicabilityZh: 定義光學引擎與平台管理整合時可被觀測的系統邊界。
records.limitationEn: The paper does not prescribe whether any management value is persistent, where it is stored, or which NVM technology is used.
records.limitationZh: 論文沒有規定哪些管理資料必須持久保存、儲存位置或採用何種 NVM 技術。
records.openQuestionEn: Which management values must survive power loss, module replacement or controller reset, and who owns them?
records.openQuestionZh: 哪些管理資料必須跨越斷電、模組更換或控制器重置而保留，且由誰負責？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Extends the secure-storage abstraction from a memory macro into a governed platform-management boundary.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把安全儲存抽象從記憶體巨集延伸到受治理的平台管理邊界。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The source establishes the interface contract, not a persistent-memory implementation.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 來源建立的是介面契約，而非持久記憶體實作。

records.titleEn: Optical diagnostics span multiple fault domains
records.titleZh: 光學診斷涵蓋多個故障域
records.claimEn: Diagnostics span optical power, laser bias/temperature, wavelength, BER/FEC and link history across multiple fault domains.
records.claimZh: 診斷範圍涵蓋光功率、雷射偏壓與溫度、波長、BER/FEC，以及跨多個故障域的鏈路歷史。
records.applicabilityEn: Defines the minimum observability needed to isolate OE, fiber, ODF, ELS and endpoint failures.
records.applicabilityZh: 定義隔離 OE、光纖、ODF、ELS 與端點故障所需的最低可觀測性。
records.limitationEn: A diagnostic signal set does not establish local retention, write rate, record size or an embedded-MTP logging requirement.
records.limitationZh: 診斷訊號集合不等於本地持久保存，也沒有建立寫入頻率、紀錄大小或嵌入式 MTP 日誌需求。
records.openQuestionEn: Which events need a local last-gasp capsule, and which should stream to BMC, host or fleet storage?
records.openQuestionZh: 哪些事件需要本地最後狀態紀錄，哪些應串流至 BMC、主機或艦隊端儲存？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Frames operational evidence as a separate layer from immutable trust and bounded configuration state.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把營運證據與不可變信任及有限次更新的設定狀態清楚分層。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The source requires observability but does not select an event-retention medium.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 來源要求可觀測性，但沒有指定事件保存媒介。

records.titleEn: Firmware lifecycle and photonic security remain open specifications
records.titleZh: 韌體生命週期與光子安全仍待規格化
records.claimEn: Signed firmware updates, version reporting and rollback are lifecycle topics; authentication, tamper detection and credential provisioning remain incomplete.
records.claimZh: 簽署韌體更新、版本回報與回復機制屬於生命週期議題；身分驗證、篡改偵測與憑證佈建仍未完成規格化。
records.applicabilityEn: Establishes the security and lifecycle work needed for managed photonic components.
records.applicabilityZh: 建立受管理光子元件所需的安全與生命週期工作範圍。
records.limitationEn: The architecture explicitly defers the secure-update path, key provisioning, tamper response and rollback semantics; it does not name OTP, MTP or a root-of-trust implementation.
records.limitationZh: 此架構明確把安全更新路徑、金鑰佈建、篡改回應與回復語意留待後續處理，也沒有指定 OTP、MTP 或信任根實作。
records.openQuestionEn: What immutable trust anchor, mutable anti-rollback state and update-recovery model will the target component use?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標元件將採用何種不可變信任錨、可更新的防回復狀態與更新復原模型？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Creates a direct bridge from secure-storage primitives to firmware integrity, anti-rollback and credential lifecycle.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把安全儲存原語直接連結到韌體完整性、防回復與憑證生命週期。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The source identifies unfinished security requirements; it does not endorse a storage technology.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 來源指出尚未完成的安全需求，但沒有背書任何儲存技術。

records.titleEn: Ring-resonator drift creates a calibration problem
records.titleZh: 環形諧振器漂移形成校準問題
records.claimEn: Ring-resonator wavelength can drift about 80 pm/K and requires thermal control.
records.claimZh: 環形諧振器的波長可能約以 80 pm/K 漂移，因此需要熱控制。
records.applicabilityEn: Supports the need for factory characterization and a controlled runtime calibration loop in ring-based optical engines.
records.applicabilityZh: 支持環形光學引擎需要出廠特性量測與受控的執行期校準迴路。
records.limitationEn: Thermal drift establishes a control need, not continuous NVM writes, a specific calibration algorithm, or an MTP endurance target.
records.limitationZh: 熱漂移只建立控制需求，不代表需要持續寫入 NVM，也沒有指定校準演算法或 MTP 耐久度目標。
records.openQuestionEn: Which calibration terms must persist across cold start, and how often can a qualified profile change?
records.openQuestionZh: 哪些校準參數必須跨越冷啟動保留，且合格設定檔可多常變更？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Provides the strongest PDF-grounded path from photonic physics to a bounded persistent calibration hypothesis.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 提供從光子物理連結到有限次持久校準假設的最直接 PDF 證據。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The source establishes drift and thermal control only; persistence is a downstream design decision.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 來源只建立漂移與熱控制需求；是否持久化是後續設計決策。

records.titleEn: OCP RAS exposes a managed operational interface
records.titleZh: OCP RAS 提供受管理的營運介面
records.claimEn: OCP RAS API endpoints expose discovery, configuration, reporting, action and event queues.
records.claimZh: OCP RAS API 端點提供探索、設定、回報、動作與事件佇列能力。
records.applicabilityEn: Defines how AI-platform health and fault information can reach management software.
records.applicabilityZh: 定義 AI 平台的健康與故障資訊如何送達管理軟體。
records.limitationEn: The API defines behavior and data exchange, not local log persistence, write endurance or the underlying storage medium.
records.limitationZh: 此 API 定義行為與資料交換，不規定本地日誌持久性、寫入耐久度或底層儲存媒介。
records.openQuestionEn: Which RAS records are configuration, bounded event capsules or high-rate streams, and what is the retention owner for each?
records.openQuestionZh: 哪些 RAS 資料屬於設定、有限事件摘要或高頻串流，各自的保存責任歸誰？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Gives Copilot and SharePoint a source-backed management contract without inventing an embedded-NVM requirement.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 為 Copilot 與 SharePoint 提供有來源依據的管理契約，同時不虛構嵌入式 NVM 需求。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The source specifies the RAS interface; storage placement remains outside its scope.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 來源規範 RAS 介面；儲存配置不在其範圍內。

records.titleEn: CMIS manages diagnostics and firmware without choosing NVM
records.titleZh: CMIS 管理診斷與韌體，但不選定 NVM
records.claimEn: CMIS supports diagnostics, interval statistics, firmware-revision reporting and module management; it does not prescribe the storage technology.
records.claimZh: CMIS 支援診斷、區間統計、韌體版本回報與模組管理，但不規定儲存技術。
records.applicabilityEn: Applies to managed optical modules and optical-engine control surfaces.
records.applicabilityZh: 適用於受管理的光學模組與光學引擎控制介面。
records.limitationEn: CMIS register behavior and statistics do not prove that a module uses OTP, MTP, EEPROM or local persistent logging.
records.limitationZh: CMIS 暫存器行為與統計功能不能證明模組採用 OTP、MTP、EEPROM 或本地持久日誌。
records.openQuestionEn: Which CMIS values are factory constants, field-updatable profiles, volatile counters or externally retained evidence?
records.openQuestionZh: 哪些 CMIS 值屬於出廠常數、現場可更新設定、揮發性計數器或外部保存證據？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Separates a standard management surface from the internal secure-storage implementation that may support it.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把標準管理介面與其內部可能採用的安全儲存實作分離。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: CMIS establishes functions and registers, not the technology or location of persistence.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: CMIS 建立功能與暫存器，但不決定持久化技術或位置。

records.titleEn: SPDM requires stable device identity but leaves provisioning open
records.titleZh: SPDM 要求穩定裝置身分，但保留佈建方式
records.claimEn: SPDM hardware identity remains constant for a device instance, while key generation and provisioning mechanisms are outside the specification.
records.claimZh: SPDM 的硬體身分在同一裝置實例中保持不變，而金鑰產生與佈建機制不在規格範圍內。
records.applicabilityEn: Provides the identity and attestation contract for managed AI devices and components.
records.applicabilityZh: 為受管理的 AI 裝置與元件提供身分及證明契約。
records.limitationEn: Identity constancy does not identify whether keys are fused, PUF-derived, provisioned externally or protected by another secure element.
records.limitationZh: 身分不變性無法判定金鑰是熔絲儲存、由 PUF 產生、外部佈建或由其他安全元件保護。
records.openQuestionEn: What threat model, provisioning authority, revocation path and recovery behavior apply to the target identity?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標身分適用何種威脅模型、佈建權限、撤銷路徑與復原行為？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Anchors the identity requirement while preserving an open choice between fused and reconstructed roots.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 建立身分需求，同時保留熔絲式與重建式信任根之間的選擇。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: SPDM specifies identity behavior but leaves key generation, storage and provisioning outside scope.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: SPDM 規範身分行為，但把金鑰產生、儲存與佈建留在規格範圍外。

records.titleEn: CXL lifecycle features combine firmware and repair state
records.titleZh: CXL 生命週期功能結合韌體與修復狀態
records.claimEn: CXL 3.2 adds online firmware activation, post-package repair enhancements, monitoring and security functions.
records.claimZh: CXL 3.2 新增線上韌體啟用、封裝後修復強化、監控與安全功能。
records.applicabilityEn: Shows that interconnect-attached AI and memory devices need coordinated firmware, repair and security lifecycle state.
records.applicabilityZh: 顯示連接於互連架構的 AI 與記憶體裝置需要協調韌體、修復與安全生命週期狀態。
records.limitationEn: The announcement identifies capabilities but does not prescribe the storage technology, data model, write count or attestation policy.
records.limitationZh: 公告指出能力，但沒有規定儲存技術、資料模型、寫入次數或證明政策。
records.openQuestionEn: How will post-package repair and firmware activation update measured state without breaking attestation coherence?
records.openQuestionZh: 封裝後修復與韌體啟用要如何更新量測狀態，同時維持證明一致性？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Connects secure storage to legitimate lifecycle changes that must remain coherent with platform measurements.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把安全儲存連結到必須與平台量測保持一致的合法生命週期變更。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The source establishes lifecycle features, not an OTP or MTP implementation.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 來源建立生命週期功能，但不是 OTP 或 MTP 實作。

records.titleEn: H100 demonstrates an on-die trust and attestation path
records.titleZh: H100 展示晶粒內信任與證明路徑
records.claimEn: NVIDIA H100 uses an on-die root of trust, secure and measured boot, SPDM and attestation.
records.claimZh: NVIDIA H100 採用晶粒內信任根、安全與量測開機、SPDM 及證明機制。
records.applicabilityEn: Demonstrates that accelerator security roots and attestation are deployed product functions, not only architecture concepts.
records.applicabilityZh: 證明加速器安全信任根與證明機制是已部署的產品功能，而不只是架構概念。
records.limitationEn: The public case does not disclose the exact NVM technology, key-generation method, invasive-attack resistance or applicability to other products.
records.limitationZh: 公開案例沒有揭露確切 NVM 技術、金鑰產生方式、侵入式攻擊抵抗力，也不能直接套用到其他產品。
records.openQuestionEn: Which immutable and mutable security states are required for the target accelerator, and how are they provisioned and revoked?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標加速器需要哪些不可變與可更新安全狀態，且如何佈建與撤銷？
records.sourceLocator: Hardware security for NVIDIA H100 GPUs
records.oipRelevanceEn: Provides a shipped-system anchor for identity, secure boot, anti-rollback and attestation discussions.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 為身分、安全開機、防回復與證明討論提供已出貨系統案例。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The product behavior is first-party evidence; its internal root storage is not disclosed here.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 產品行為屬於第一方證據，但此來源未揭露內部信任根的儲存方式。

records.titleEn: GPU row remapping persists as bounded repair state
records.titleZh: GPU 列重映射形成有限的持久修復狀態
records.claimEn: GPU row remapping is persistent for device life and can support up to 512 remappings on the cited product family.
records.claimZh: GPU 列重映射可在裝置生命週期內持久保留，且引用的產品系列最高可支援 512 次重映射。
records.applicabilityEn: Demonstrates a bounded, lifecycle-long repair-state workload in production accelerators.
records.applicabilityZh: 證明量產加速器中存在次數有限、跨越裝置生命週期的修復狀態工作負載。
records.limitationEn: The 512-remap limit is product-family-specific and does not reveal the physical storage technology, atomic update mechanism or security policy.
records.limitationZh: 512 次重映射是特定產品系列的限制，沒有揭露實體儲存技術、原子更新機制或安全政策。
records.openQuestionEn: What repair count, granularity, retention and failure-recovery guarantees are required on the target accelerator?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標加速器需要多少修復次數、何種粒度、保存年限與失敗復原保證？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Shows why repair state needs bounded mutability, recovery and lifecycle governance rather than a generic fuse assumption.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 說明修復狀態需要有限次可更新性、復原與生命週期治理，而不能只以一般熔絲假設處理。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The cited product proves persistent repair behavior, not a universal implementation or endurance number.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 引用產品證明持久修復行為，但不代表通用實作或耐久度數字。

records.titleEn: Fuse-programmed HBM repair can change attestation measurements
records.titleZh: 熔絲編程的 HBM 修復可能改變證明量測
records.claimEn: Fuse-programmed HBM channel repair can alter physical measurements verified during attestation.
records.claimZh: 以熔絲編程的 HBM 通道修復可能改變證明流程所驗證的實體量測。
records.applicabilityEn: Demonstrates that legitimate persistent repair can affect the measured identity of an accelerator platform.
records.applicabilityZh: 證明合法的持久修復可能影響加速器平台的量測身分。
records.limitationEn: The advisory is product- and driver-specific; it does not establish a universal fuse type, repair capacity or attestation design.
records.limitationZh: 此公告僅適用特定產品與驅動程式，沒有建立通用熔絲類型、修復容量或證明設計。
records.openQuestionEn: How will authorized repair transitions be signed, measured and reconciled with attestation policy?
records.openQuestionZh: 授權的修復狀態轉換要如何簽署、量測並與證明政策保持一致？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Makes attestation coherence a first-class secure-storage requirement for lifecycle repair state.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把證明一致性提升為生命週期修復狀態的第一級安全儲存需求。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The case proves a fuse-programmed repair interaction; it does not generalize the physical fuse implementation.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 案例證明熔絲編程修復與證明之間的互動，但不能推廣到所有實體熔絲實作。

records.titleEn: A fusebox can hold repair data with very few programming sessions
records.titleZh: Fusebox 可保存修復資料，但編程次數可能極少
records.claimEn: A fusebox stores memory-repair information and may allow only a very limited number of programming sessions.
records.claimZh: Fusebox 儲存記憶體修復資訊，且可能只允許非常有限的編程次數。
records.applicabilityEn: Provides a concrete DFT workflow for persistent SRAM-repair information.
records.applicabilityZh: 提供持久 SRAM 修復資訊的具體 DFT 工作流程。
records.limitationEn: The workflow is vendor-specific; session count, fuse technology, field-repair support and capacity depend on the implementation.
records.limitationZh: 此工作流程為供應商特定實作；編程次數、熔絲技術、現場修復支援與容量皆取決於具體設計。
records.openQuestionEn: Does the target require factory-only repair, bounded field repair, or both, and how many atomic update sessions are needed?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標需要僅出廠修復、有限次現場修復，或兩者都需要？又需要多少次原子更新？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Shows that repair-state capacity and write-session topology must be defined before choosing OTP or managed NVM.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 說明選擇 OTP 或受管理 NVM 前，必須先定義修復資料容量與寫入次數模型。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The source documents a workflow, not a universal repair-memory architecture.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 來源記錄的是工作流程，而非通用修復記憶體架構。

records.titleEn: PMIC boot truth can be loaded from OTP
records.titleZh: PMIC 開機基準可由 OTP 載入
records.claimEn: PF8100/PF8200 loads device boot configuration from an OTP fuse bank into mirror and functional registers.
records.claimZh: PF8100/PF8200 會把裝置開機設定從 OTP fuse bank 載入鏡像與功能暫存器。
records.applicabilityEn: Demonstrates an immutable PMIC startup baseline that is copied into volatile control state at boot.
records.applicabilityZh: 證明 PMIC 可在開機時把不可變啟動基準複製到揮發性控制狀態。
records.limitationEn: This PMIC family does not establish that every AI power controller needs OTP, runtime recalibration or a high-rate persistent log.
records.limitationZh: 此 PMIC 系列不能證明所有 AI 電源控制器都需要 OTP、執行期重新校準或高頻持久日誌。
records.openQuestionEn: Which startup rails, sequencing limits and fail-safe values must be immutable on the target PMIC?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標 PMIC 的哪些啟動電源軌、時序限制與失效安全值必須不可變？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Provides a shipped example of OTP baseline plus volatile runtime state at a power-control boundary.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 提供電源控制邊界採用 OTP 基準加揮發性執行狀態的已出貨案例。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The use of OTP is demonstrated for this component family; it is not a universal PMIC requirement.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 此元件系列證明了 OTP 的使用，但不代表所有 PMIC 都有相同要求。

records.titleEn: EEPROM black-box logging exposes endurance and power-fail limits
records.titleZh: EEPROM 黑盒日誌揭示耐久度與斷電限制
records.claimEn: ADP1055 EEPROM black-box logging is bounded by temperature-dependent record limits and requires power hold-up for reliable final writes.
records.claimZh: ADP1055 的 EEPROM 黑盒日誌受溫度相關的記錄次數限制，且可靠完成最後寫入需要電源維持時間。
records.applicabilityEn: Demonstrates the workload analysis required before placing fault evidence in embedded rewritable NVM.
records.applicabilityZh: 證明把故障證據放入可重寫嵌入式 NVM 前，必須先完成工作負載分析。
records.limitationEn: The record limits and hold-up behavior are specific to this device and cannot be generalized to Logic MTP, every PMIC or arbitrary event rates.
records.limitationZh: 記錄限制與電源維持行為只適用此裝置，不能直接推廣到 Logic MTP、所有 PMIC 或任意事件頻率。
records.openQuestionEn: What event rate, temperature profile, record size and hold-up energy define the target black-box workload?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標黑盒工作負載的事件頻率、溫度曲線、紀錄大小與電源維持能量為何？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Turns telemetry persistence into a bounded workload question instead of an unqualified MTP claim.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把遙測持久化轉化為有界工作負載問題，而不是未經限定的 MTP 宣稱。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The cited device demonstrates bounded EEPROM logging; it does not prove universal embedded-log fitness.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 引用裝置證明有界 EEPROM 日誌，但不能證明嵌入式日誌普遍適用。

records.titleEn: UCIe MTP means Management Transport Protocol
records.titleZh: UCIe 的 MTP 指 Management Transport Protocol
records.claimEn: UCIe 2.0 adds manageability and DFx lifecycle features; its MTP acronym means Management Transport Protocol, not multiple-time-programmable memory.
records.claimZh: UCIe 2.0 新增可管理性與 DFx 生命週期功能；其中 MTP 是 Management Transport Protocol，而非多次可程式化記憶體。
records.applicabilityEn: Prevents acronym collision when mapping chiplet manageability functions to persistent-state opportunities.
records.applicabilityZh: 避免把晶粒互連管理功能映射到持久狀態機會時發生縮寫混淆。
records.limitationEn: Manageability and DFx lifecycle functions do not themselves require multiple-time-programmable memory.
records.limitationZh: 可管理性與 DFx 生命週期功能本身不代表需要多次可程式化記憶體。
records.openQuestionEn: Which UCIe management or DFx state, if any, must survive reset or power loss in the target implementation?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標實作中有哪些 UCIe 管理或 DFx 狀態必須跨越重置或斷電保留？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Protects the evidence ledger from treating a protocol acronym as a memory requirement.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 防止證據帳本把通訊協定縮寫誤當成記憶體需求。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: This is an acronym and lifecycle clarification, not evidence for MTP memory deployment.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 這是縮寫與生命週期釐清，不是部署 MTP 記憶體的證據。

records.titleEn: OTP vendors position immutable storage across several workloads
records.titleZh: OTP 供應商將不可變儲存定位於多種工作負載
records.claimEn: Synopsys positions OTP for configuration, trimming, calibration, keys, code and repair across a broad process range.
records.claimZh: Synopsys 將 OTP 定位於多種製程中的設定、微調、校準、金鑰、程式碼與修復用途。
records.applicabilityEn: Provides a public capability envelope for immutable and rare-write state.
records.applicabilityZh: 提供不可變與極少次寫入狀態的公開能力範圍。
records.limitationEn: A product overview is not independent certification; exact node, capacity, PPA, temperature, security and qualification claims must be checked per macro.
records.limitationZh: 產品概覽不等於獨立認證；製程節點、容量、PPA、溫度、安全性與資格宣告都必須逐一針對巨集確認。
records.openQuestionEn: Which released macro and node satisfy the target capacity, program supply, retention, qualification and threat model?
records.openQuestionZh: 哪一個已發布巨集與節點能符合目標容量、編程供電、保存、資格與威脅模型？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Defines commodity OTP use cases while keeping secure-storage assurance and node readiness as separate evidence gates.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 定義一般 OTP 使用案例，同時把安全儲存確證與節點成熟度維持為獨立證據關卡。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: This is a vendor-stated envelope and must not be presented as independent assurance.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 這是供應商宣告的能力範圍，不得描述為獨立確證。

records.titleEn: MTP endurance is a product envelope, not a universal category
records.titleZh: MTP 耐久度是產品能力範圍，不是通用類別
records.claimEn: eMemory NeoMTP is one MTP class with a vendor-stated 1K-cycle envelope; MTP is not a universal endurance category.
records.claimZh: eMemory NeoMTP 是一種 MTP 類別，供應商宣告其耐久度範圍為 1K 次；MTP 並不是具有統一耐久度的通用類別。
records.applicabilityEn: Demonstrates why MTP selection must begin with a bounded update workload rather than a generic cycle assumption.
records.applicabilityZh: 說明 MTP 選型必須從有界更新工作負載出發，而不是套用一般循環次數假設。
records.limitationEn: The 1K-cycle figure applies to the cited vendor class and does not characterize every MTP macro, node, temperature or retention target.
records.limitationZh: 1K 次僅適用引用的供應商類別，不能代表所有 MTP 巨集、節點、溫度或保存目標。
records.openQuestionEn: What guaranteed cycle count, retention temperature, atomicity and error-management behavior does the target macro provide?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標巨集可保證多少次寫入、何種保存溫度、原子性與錯誤管理行為？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Prevents the presentation from treating a single MTP endurance number as an industry-wide truth.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 避免簡報把單一 MTP 耐久度數字描述成全產業通則。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The cycle envelope is vendor-stated and product-specific, not independently generalized.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 循環次數範圍是供應商宣告且產品特定，不能未經獨立證據加以泛化。

records.titleEn: Immutable AI identity and lifecycle locks are plausible OTP or PUF-root opportunities
records.titleZh: 不可變 AI 身分與生命週期鎖是可能的 OTP 或 PUF 根機會
records.claimEn: AI accelerator identity, immutable fail-safe defaults and lifecycle locks are plausible OTP/PUF-root opportunities.
records.claimZh: AI 加速器身分、不可變失效安全預設值與生命週期鎖，是可能的 OTP 或 PUF 根應用機會。
records.applicabilityEn: Applies when a target AI device requires small, immutable trust and lifecycle state at silicon boundary.
records.applicabilityZh: 適用於目標 AI 裝置需要少量、不可變的晶片邊界信任與生命週期狀態時。
records.limitationEn: Requires target threat model, provisioning design and node qualification.
records.limitationZh: 需要目標威脅模型、佈建設計與製程節點資格證據。
records.openQuestionEn: Should the target root be fused, PUF-derived or held by another secure element, and what evidence closes that choice?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標信任根應採熔絲、PUF 重建或由其他安全元件保存？需要哪些證據才能完成選擇？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Extends the Secure Storage abstraction to AI identity without claiming that PUF is universally superior to fused state.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把安全儲存抽象延伸到 AI 身分，同時不宣稱 PUF 普遍優於熔絲狀態。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: This placement is an architecture hypothesis synthesized from adjacent requirements and proof cases.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 此配置是由相鄰需求與案例綜合推導的架構假設。

records.titleEn: Repair, calibration and rollback state are bounded-mutable opportunities
records.titleZh: 修復、校準與回復狀態是有限次可更新的機會
records.claimEn: Bounded repair, calibration, configuration and rollback state are plausible MTP or managed-NVM opportunities.
records.claimZh: 次數有限的修復、校準、設定與回復狀態，是可能的 MTP 或受管理 NVM 應用機會。
records.applicabilityEn: Applies when state must change after manufacture but has a bounded event count and explicit recovery semantics.
records.applicabilityZh: 適用於狀態需在製造後變更，但事件次數有限且具有明確復原語意的情境。
records.limitationEn: Requires write cadence, atomicity, retention temperature and ownership definition.
records.limitationZh: 需要定義寫入頻率、原子性、保存溫度與資料責任歸屬。
records.openQuestionEn: How many updates, how many bytes and what power-fail recovery guarantee define each target workload?
records.openQuestionZh: 每個目標工作負載需要多少次更新、多少位元組，以及何種斷電復原保證？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Defines the mutable layer that complements an immutable root and keeps live control loops volatile.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 定義與不可變信任根互補的可更新層，並讓即時控制迴路維持揮發性。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: This is a selection hypothesis; every workload requires quantified endurance, retention and recovery evidence.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 這是選型假設；每個工作負載都需要量化的耐久度、保存與復原證據。

records.titleEn: High-rate telemetry should not default to embedded MTP
records.titleZh: 高頻遙測不應預設採用嵌入式 MTP
records.claimEn: High-rate telemetry should not default to embedded MTP; use buffering, event reduction and external storage unless a bounded workload proves otherwise.
records.claimZh: 高頻遙測不應預設使用嵌入式 MTP；除非有界工作負載能證明其適用性，否則應採緩衝、事件縮減與外部儲存。
records.applicabilityEn: Applies to optical telemetry, CPER/RAS events, PMIC black-box records and other potentially high-write operational evidence.
records.applicabilityZh: 適用於光學遙測、CPER/RAS 事件、PMIC 黑盒紀錄與其他可能高寫入量的營運證據。
records.limitationEn: Validate event rate, record size, power-fail behavior and service retention.
records.limitationZh: 需要驗證事件頻率、紀錄大小、斷電行為與維修保存需求。
records.openQuestionEn: Can event reduction and last-gasp capture bound the local write workload, or should all evidence remain external?
records.openQuestionZh: 事件縮減與最後狀態擷取能否把本地寫入量限制在可控範圍，或所有證據都應保留於外部？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Prevents the site and presentation from turning a telemetry requirement into an unsupported MTP volume claim.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 避免網站與簡報把遙測需求轉化成未經支持的 MTP 容量宣稱。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: This is a conservative validation rule, not a source-mandated architecture.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 這是保守的驗證規則，不是來源強制的架構。

records.titleEn: Synopsys publicly lists a 40nm 2.5V-device-class MTP
records.titleZh: Synopsys 公開列有 40nm 2.5V device-class MTP
records.claimEn: Synopsys publicly lists a TSMC 40nm LP MTP EEPROM in the 2.5V process-I/O gate-oxide class, and its advanced-node MTP datasheet positions the family from 65nm to 40nm.
records.claimZh: Synopsys 公開列有 TSMC 40nm LP、2.5V process-I/O gate-oxide class 的 MTP EEPROM，其先進節點 MTP datasheet 將產品家族定位於 65nm 到 40nm。
records.applicabilityEn: Provides a public anchor for logic-compatible floating-gate MTP at a lower process-I/O device class than representative 3.3V or 5V offerings.
records.applicabilityZh: 提供 logic-compatible floating-gate MTP 在低於代表性 3.3V 或 5V 方案之 process-I/O device class 的公開錨點。
records.limitationEn: The component listing does not prove market exclusivity, current commercial terms, or availability outside the cited process and macro release.
records.limitationZh: 此 component listing 不能證明市場唯一性、目前商務條件，或引用製程與 macro release 之外的供應狀態。
records.openQuestionEn: Which released macro, foundry option and qualification envelope are available for the target program?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標專案可取得哪一個已發布 macro、foundry option 與 qualification envelope？
records.sourceLocator: TSMC 40nm LP 2.5V MTP component page and advanced-node MTP datasheet
records.oipRelevanceEn: Defines a public MTP portability anchor without turning one product listing into a market-wide exclusivity claim.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 定義公開的 MTP portability 錨點，同時不把單一產品 listing 擴大成市場排他性主張。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: Verified public offering; exclusivity and commercial availability remain outside the public proof boundary.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 可確認公開產品；市場唯一性與商業供應狀態不在公開證據邊界內。

records.titleEn: Representative zero-mask floating-gate MTP uses 3.3V or 5V devices
records.titleZh: 代表性 zero-mask floating-gate MTP 採用 3.3V 或 5V devices
records.claimEn: eMemory states that NeoMTP reuses 3.3V or 5V I/O devices with no additional masks; its published retention envelopes differ between the 3.3V and 5V gate-oxide device classes.
records.claimZh: eMemory 表示 NeoMTP 重用 3.3V 或 5V I/O devices 且不增加 masks；其公開 retention envelope 也依 3.3V 與 5V gate-oxide device class 而不同。
records.applicabilityEn: Shows how a zero-mask floating-gate MTP inherits available process-device options and why retention must be evaluated at the exact macro, oxide class and temperature.
records.applicabilityZh: 說明 zero-mask floating-gate MTP 如何承接既有 process-device options，以及 retention 為何必須依確切 macro、oxide class 與溫度評估。
records.limitationEn: This is one public product family. Retention also depends on the full dielectric system, defects, cycling stress and temperature, not oxide thickness alone.
records.limitationZh: 這只代表一個公開產品家族。Retention 還取決於完整 dielectric system、defects、cycling stress 與溫度，不是只由 oxide thickness 決定。
records.openQuestionEn: What retention, cycling and temperature evidence applies to the exact target macro and process option?
records.openQuestionZh: 確切目標 macro 與 process option 適用哪些 retention、cycling 與溫度證據？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Frames oxide availability as a process-portability constraint while preserving product-specific retention evidence.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把 oxide availability 定位為 process portability constraint，同時保留產品特定的 retention 證據邊界。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: This representative vendor example cannot support the claim that every non-Synopsys MTP requires 3.3V or 5V devices.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 此代表性供應商案例不能支持所有非 Synopsys MTP 都需要 3.3V 或 5V devices 的說法。

records.titleEn: A published 28nm eFlash implementation adds memory-specific process modules
records.titleZh: 公開 28nm eFlash 實例加入 memory-specific process modules
records.claimEn: A published 28nm split-gate eFlash implementation combines a 1.8V logic-device platform with flash-specific dielectric, high-voltage devices, a triple-gate-oxide flow and additional masks.
records.claimZh: 公開的 28nm split-gate eFlash 實例，將 1.8V logic-device platform 與 flash-specific dielectric、high-voltage devices、triple-gate-oxide flow 及額外 masks 整合。
records.applicabilityEn: Demonstrates how dedicated eFlash process modules can coexist with a low-voltage logic baseline without eliminating high-field program and erase requirements.
records.applicabilityZh: 說明 dedicated eFlash process modules 如何與低電壓 logic baseline 共存，但不會消除 program 與 erase 的高電場需求。
records.limitationEn: The mask count and device stack are implementation-specific. Commercial adoption depends on mask cost, process-development burden, yield learning and qualification rather than an absolute physical node limit.
records.limitationZh: Mask 數量與 device stack 屬於特定實作。商業採用取決於 mask cost、process-development burden、yield learning 與 qualification，而不是絕對物理節點限制。
records.openQuestionEn: What process adders, voltage devices, reliability qualification and cost apply to the target eFlash platform?
records.openQuestionZh: 目標 eFlash platform 需要哪些 process adders、voltage devices、reliability qualification 與成本？
records.oipRelevanceEn: Separates the low-voltage logic baseline from the process and high-voltage mechanisms that enable rewritable embedded flash.
records.oipRelevanceZh: 把低電壓 logic baseline 與實現可重寫 embedded flash 的製程及高電壓機制分開。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: The paper is a measured implementation example, not a universal process recipe. The owner-provided industry note that SST ESF3 adds more than 20 masks, constraining adoption while programs extend ESF2, remains a project-level market observation for internal validation.

records.titleEn: Microarchitectural Transient Fault Isolation & Side-Channel Mitigation
records.titleZh: 微架構暫態故障隔離與側信道防護機制
records.claimEn: Non-volatile memory controllers must implement microarchitectural domain fence isolation and deterministic pipeline flushing to prevent transient execution leaks and speculatively cached key reconstruction.
records.claimZh: 非揮發性記憶體控制器必須實作微架構網域隔離柵欄（Domain Fence）與確定性管線刷新，防止暫態執行洩漏與推測性快取金鑰重構。
records.applicabilityEn: Multi-tenant AI accelerator memory controllers, virtualized enclave controllers, and secure DMA bridges.
records.applicabilityZh: 多租戶 AI 加速器記憶體控制器、虛擬化飛地 (Enclave) 控制器與安全 DMA 橋接器。
records.limitationEn: Transient isolation fences introduce a 1-3 cycle latency penalty on speculative bus reads.
records.limitationZh: 暫態隔離柵欄會在推測性總線讀取時引入 1-3 個週期的延遲開銷。
records.openQuestionEn: How does transient fence verification scale across deeply out-of-order multi-core AI control clusters?
records.openQuestionZh: 暫態柵欄驗證在深度亂序多核 AI 控制叢集中應如何擴展？

records.oipRelevanceZh: TSMC 先進製程處理器 IP 核心整合與暫態側信道免疫設計。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: Validated against ISO/IEC 17825 TVLA and transient execution vulnerability benchmarks.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 依據 ISO/IEC 17825 TVLA 與暫態執行漏洞基準驗證。

records.titleEn: Quantum Equivocation & Post-Quantum Symmetric Key Margins
records.titleZh: 量子多義性防護與後量子對稱金鑰安全餘裕
records.claimEn: To maintain effective 128-bit security against Grover's quantum search algorithm (which halves symmetric key strength), next-generation hardware security engines require native 256-bit to 512-bit entropy roots provisioned via SRAM PUF and AntiFuse OTP.
records.claimZh: 為抵禦格羅弗（Grover）量子搜尋演算法（將對稱金鑰強度折半）並維持實質 128 位元安全強度，新世代硬體安全引擎必須原生具備由 SRAM PUF 與 AntiFuse OTP 提供的 256 至 512 位元熵根。
records.applicabilityEn: PQC Roots of Trust, long-lifecycle defense satellites, and financial ledger signing engines.
records.applicabilityZh: 後量子信任根、長生命週期國防衛星與金融帳本簽章引擎。
records.limitationEn: 512-bit entropy generation requires double the PUF bitcell area and extended enrollment time.
records.limitationZh: 512 位元熵生成需兩倍 PUF 單元面積與較長的註冊時間。
records.openQuestionEn: What is the optimal entropy compression ratio to ensure full Shannon entropy across wide PUF arrays?
records.openQuestionZh: 在大規模 PUF 陣列中確保完整夏農熵之最佳熵壓縮比為何？
records.oipRelevanceEn: TSMC N3P/N2 post-quantum crypto hardware accelerator enablement.
records.oipRelevanceZh: TSMC N3P/N2 後量子密碼硬體加速器設計生態系支援。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: Derived from NIST Post-Quantum Transition Timeline and symmetric key strength requirements.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 依據 NIST 後量子轉型時程與對稱金鑰強度規範推導。

records.titleEn: Automotive FIT Rate & Arrhenius Lifetime Qualification
records.titleZh: 車用 FIT 失效率與阿瑞尼斯壽命加速測試確證
records.claimEn: High-reliability automotive and AI infrastructure NVM macros achieve FIT < 0.1 per megabit over a 15-to-20 year operational lifespan at Tj = 125°C to 150°C, validated via Arrhenius thermal acceleration modeling (Ea = 0.9 eV).
records.claimZh: 高可靠度車用與 AI 基礎設施 NVM 巨集在 Tj = 125°C 至 150°C 條件下，透過阿瑞尼斯（Arrhenius）熱加速模型（Ea = 0.9 eV）驗證，可達成 15 至 20 年運作壽命且 FIT < 0.1 / Mb 之失效率水準。
records.applicabilityEn: AEC-Q100 Grade 0/1 automotive MCUs, ADAS compute platforms, and mission-critical cloud power stages.
records.applicabilityZh: AEC-Q100 Grade 0/1 車用微控制器、ADAS 運算平台與關鍵任務雲端電源模組。
records.limitationEn: High-temperature retention models require HTOL (High-Temperature Operating Life) testing at 175°C for > 1000 hours.
records.limitationZh: 高溫留存模型需進行 175°C、大於 1000 小時之 HTOL 高溫運作壽命測試。

records.titleEn: UCIe 2.0 Low-Latency Flit Pipeline Architecture & D2D Stream Encryption
records.titleZh: UCIe 2.0 低延遲 Flit 管線架構與晶粒間串流加密
records.claimEn: UCIe 2.0 streaming protocols necessitate sub-2ns hardware AES-GCM-256 / AES-CTR encryption engines at the Flit level, binding ephemeral D2D keys generated from on-die PUF instances across multi-die packages.
records.claimZh: UCIe 2.0 串流協定要求在 Flit 級實作低於 2ns 延遲之 AES-GCM-256 / AES-CTR 硬體加密引擎，並綁定由多晶粒封裝內各晶粒 PUF 產生的暫態 D2D 會話金鑰。
records.applicabilityEn: 2.5D/3D advanced packaging systems (CoWoS, EMIB, SoIC) interconnecting compute, memory, and optical I/O chiplets.
records.applicabilityZh: 整合運算、記憶體與光學 I/O 晶粒之 2.5D/3D 先進封裝系統（CoWoS、EMIB、SoIC）。
records.limitationEn: High-throughput Flit encryption requires dedicated pipelined Galois multiplier hardware within the Die-to-Die adapter.
records.limitationZh: 高吞吐量 Flit 加密需要在晶粒間配接器內整合專屬管線化伽羅瓦乘法器（Galois Multiplier）硬體。
records.openQuestionEn: What is the power and area overhead of multi-lane Flit ciphers operating at 32 Gbps/pin D2D data rates?
records.openQuestionZh: 在 32 Gbps/pin 晶粒間資料速率下，多通道 Flit 加密引擎的功耗與面積開銷為何？

records.oipRelevanceZh: TSMC 3DFabric CoWoS / SoIC UCIe PHY 與控制器 IP 設計支援。
records.evidenceBoundaryEn: Directly aligned with UCIe 2.0 specification security extensions.
records.evidenceBoundaryZh: 完全對齊 UCIe 2.0 規範之安全擴展條文。

records.titleEn: Co-Packaged Optics & Silicon Photonics Non-Volatile Alignment Calibration
records.titleZh: 共封裝光學 (CPO) 與矽光子非揮發性對準校準狀態保存
records.claimEn: Silicon Photonics (PIC) and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) engines require dedicated on-die non-volatile trim registers (MTP/OTP) to preserve optical phase bias, micro-ring heater calibration, and Mach-Zehnder interferometer operating points across power cycles.
records.claimZh: 矽光子 (PIC) 與共封裝光學 (CPO) 引擎需要專屬晶片內建非揮發性微調暫存器（MTP/OTP），以跨越電源週期保存光相位偏壓、微環加熱器校準與馬赫-曾德爾干涉儀（MZI）工作點。
records.applicabilityEn: 51.2T/102.4T CPO network switches, optical compute interconnects (OCI), and disaggregated optical AI cluster fabrics.
records.applicabilityZh: 51.2T/102.4T CPO 網路交換器、光學運算互連 (OCI) 與分散式光學 AI 叢集 Fabric。
records.limitationEn: High-precision optical calibration requires 12-to-16 bit DAC resolution and atomic write protection against power brownouts.
records.limitationZh: 高精度光學校準需要 12 至 16 位元 DAC 解析度，並具備抵禦掉電之原子寫入保護。
